title: Rav Yehudah bar Ishtata
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Eruvin 52a he brings Rav Natan bar Ishaya a basket of fruit, on a festival. As he is leaving, Rav Natan lets him descend a step before telling him, “Lodge here,” that is, stay here overnight; the next day he leaves early. The Arukh, under Ashtita, explains it as a personal name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The parenthetical festival and lodge-here glosses belong to Hyman. Eruvin 52a names the host Natan bar Oshaya; the supplied notice spells Ishaya. The Arukh’s lemma Ashtita differs from the heading Ishtata.
The statement about the Arukh’s personal-name explanation is Hyman’s report. The spellings אישתתא, אשתיתא and אישעיא remain distinct; the article makes no further personal identification.
